question: If E % F means E is the brother of F, E & F means E is the sister of F and E $ F means E is the daughter of F, then what does P% Q & R $ S mean?

options.text: P is the daughter of S
S is the son of P
S is the daughter of P
P is the son of S

P% Q & R $ S → P is brother of Q, Q is sister of R, R is daughter of S.

The family tree diagram is shown below:

1) P is the daughter of S → False

2) S is the son of P→ False

3) S is the daughter of P→ False

4) P is the son of S → True

Hence, P is the son of S.
